style.name: Parisian Midcentury
style.definition: Elegant artwork and a touch of brass meet sculptural midcentury walnut furniture.
style.materials: walnut; tobacco velvet; cream wool; brass; marble
style.living: cream curved sofa; tobacco velvet walnut lounge chair; oval marble coffee table on walnut legs; walnut media credenza; round walnut table with four cream upholstered chairs; brass globe pendant; large abstract art and a small antique frame
style.bed: cream curved queen headboard; ivory bedding and tobacco throw; walnut nightstands with brass dome lamps
style.solarium: teak outdoor seating with tobacco performance cushions; round teak dining set
style.implement: Pair one antique-looking artwork with clean walnut furniture; keep walls and ceiling architecture intact.
style.avoid: Avoid imitation Haussmann paneling that changes the condo shell.
